title.zh: Abracadabra blames hacks for shutdown amid ‘looting’ claims
title.en: Abracadabra blames hacks for shutdown amid ‘looting’ claims

current_state.zh: Abracadabra has moved to wind down the protocol after repeated hacks left its Magic Internet Money stablecoin with 22 million outstanding MIM against roughly $900,000 in actionable backing, prompting accusations of 'treasury looting' over earlier governance actions.
current_state.en: Abracadabra has moved to wind down the protocol after repeated hacks left its Magic Internet Money stablecoin with 22 million outstanding MIM against roughly $900,000 in actionable backing, prompting accusations of 'treasury looting' over earlier governance actions.
